intro.text: We are a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company pioneering the discovery and development of a new class of RNA-targeting therapeutics with the goal of upregulating gene expression and restoring healthy protein levels to treat a broad range of genetic diseases. Our lead product candidate, CMP-002, has the potential to be the first disease-modifying therapy for the treatment of synaptic Ras GTPase activating protein 1 (“SYNGAP1”)-related disorder, or SYNGAP1, a severe developmental and epileptic encephalopathy (“DEE”) characterized by seizures, developmental delays, and cognitive impairments. SYNGAP1 is caused by haploinsufficiency of the SYNGAP1 gene, where mutation of one gene copy results in a reduction in functional SYNGAP protein levels of up to 50%.
